name: Torino Tsukiko
source:
She is a kouhai, who confessed to Fuuta and became his girlfriend. Her bright personality, coupled with her small constitution, makes an impressive combination. She is still very young. She told Fuuta about her feelings directly and was happy due to longing for him for so long.

[Translated from the [url=http://bellkage.blog.jp/yubikiri.html]official site[/url]].
